# Epilogue: Holy Ruler

Holy Ruler

“We return this land to order and prosperity, we bring to it a balanced rule, a stewardship until such time that we are able to return a ruler who is worthy of your obedience, we return the nobility to there lands and bring back the rules and dictates of the Emporer, the true ruler of this land. We the Messenger s of Aurtus will ensure continuity until a new Emporer or Empress is found.” The Lord Reagent announced to the gathered people of Vicor, the entire commons were packed with nobles and common alike as a cheer rose up to greet his words. The Lord Reagent spoke from the balcony of the palace where the church now ruled.

Nero had returned prosperity, freed the children and shutdown the tower. Things were beginning to look like they would come back to normal Marcus thought leaning in the doorway and watching the speech.

Soldiers walked by eyeing his clothing, the outlook towards mages had not improved but at the same time the church had not spoken of the agreement, or their intentions. Marcus hoped for the best and sighed as he turned back towards the room where His friends sat Corliss now the Lord Adjudicator of the new Wardens stood resplendent in her new leather armor complete with the crest of the wardens emblazoned upon it, Uri having retired to live in peace with the Silvan’s, Dara, Maelen and Patrice now sat around the small table listening as the Reagent continued to speak of prosperity and peace.

“So, what’s next?” Maelen asked looking towards Marcus who shifted uncomfortably his friend had seen the packed back by the door and knew what that meant. “I am heading North, there is a lot to see and this place holds too many bad memories for now” he said and could see Dara’s face fall. “Your leaving?” she asked coming over to him and Marcus took the young mage by the shoulders. “There is something out there, something I can’t explain the Empress said some things to me that leads me to believe she saw it too” he said lowly “I am going to find out what I can, I will be back, but there is a lot that I need to find out” he finished.

The speech ended to applause and Marcus nodded to his friends. Corliss came over first “Look me up when you come back Marcus, a lot of whats going on today is because of you, for that you have my thanks” she said giving him a hug and then stepping back. Maelen walked him out “Where will you go, back to the Silvan’s?” he asked walking with his friend as he left the small house and headed towards the stables. Marcus was quiet for a few minutes and then looked at his friend “Not sure, I think I am going to find out what else is out there, Durass spoke of other people further north, I want to see if they might know something about these dreams” he said. His friend was quiet for a long time. “When you come back, we should have the order back, if the new ruler allows it” he said wincing, knowing how Nero felt about the mages.

“Take care my friend, I will see you when I get back” Marcus said giving his friend a hug and then walking on, leaving Maelen looking after him as Marcus mounted the large cat that stood outside the stables, since the stable boy wouldn’t go near the large animal.

He rode out of the capital and headed north, looking back at the capital he lowered his head and whispered a small prayer for his friends and then turned heading into the setting sun.


---

*To be concluded in Book Three of the Earth Reborn Trilogy: **Fall of the Empire (Draconis)***
